event.description: Share K/V projection across two attention heads
event.proposal: family: attention organization; retained incumbent is 4288 parameters at 99.9100%, a +0.91 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none; same-family failed result: none; prior attempts in this family: 0. The latest position-representation probes 0005 and 0014 scored 8.85% and 0.11%, so this proposal changes the attention mechanism rather than revisiting position compression. Hypothesis: two query subspaces can attend through shared keys and values, preserving two attention heads while replacing the per-head-expanded qkv projection with a d-by-d query plus d-by-d_head shared K/V projection; at d16,h2 this removes 256 parameters per block and yields 3776 total parameters. This is more informative than a one-head deletion because it isolates K/V sharing while retaining independent queries and the same causal attention depth. Keep learned positions, reversed operands, ff20, and 30000-step training; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 4288 parameters.
